svg.title: Paralichthys dentatus — all years and life stages
svg.desc: Geographic specimen-count heatmap. Numbered grid cells connect to collection-year labels with specimen counts in parentheses for each cell and year. Hatched cells include approximate positions; Undated marks specimens without an assigned year.
svg.text: All years and stages · 53 specimens · 53 plotted · 0 without a usable location
42 recorded-coordinate specimens + 11 approximate positions plotted; labels list collection years
Specimens per 2° × 2° cell · log color scale · colors are scaled separately for each species
Hatching includes approximate locations. Blank cells indicate no plotted sampling, not biological absence.
